text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Students at Tracen often compete with
each other in scrimmage races as part of
their training regimens. Silence Suzuka is
taking part in one
such race today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still concerned after seeing how troubled
she appeared in the library
the other day, I
decide to come out to observe her.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, I take it that you understand the
objective of this scrimmage,
yes?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... To practice the techniques I'll be
using in my debut race.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That's correct. Your debut is coming up
next month.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
We've been focusing on having you better
conserve your speed and
energy. It's time
to put everything to practice in a proper
race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Okay...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to this day,
Suzuka. Show me how far
you've come
under your trainer's guidance.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I won't be giving up the lead.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh. I couldn't have said it better
myself,
so right back at you. I'm
heading for the
gates now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All I have to do is remember what she
taught me—conserve energy at
the start
and save it for the final leg...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Right... I've got this.
This is the way it's
supposed to be done. I'll win
for sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The gates spring open on Silence Suzuka's
latest scrimmage race.
However...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... I still need to conserve my
energy...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To anyone who witnessed her tremendous
lead during her tryout race,
today's
Silence Suzuka appears to be an entirely
different runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No doubt she is trying to implement new
speed conservation techniques introduced
by her new trainer.
But it's hard to say if 
they're effective...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Pant... Gasp...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She finds herself surrounded by her
rivals; distress and frustration are

uncharacteristicallyscrawled across her
face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She staggers into the race's final leg...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: This is the homestretch... Now!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
W-wait... My legs... don't have the
energy...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This ends here!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if set off by Air Groove's own final
push, the other runners begin to overtake
Silence Suzuka one after another, leaving
her buried at the
back of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I can't see anything...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: My view... is gone...

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Eighth place...
A regrettable finish indeed.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You stuck to the plan and performed
brilliantly in the first half of the
race, but
you weren't able to break away in the
second half. Why is that?

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text: Suzuka? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... I-I'm sorry... Um...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm honestly... not sure. I don't...
I don't
know what happened...

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...I see. These things can take some time,
so it's safe to say you might
not be used to
this strategy yet.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
In that case, why don't we push back your
debut race? This is not the
time to be
reckless.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Eh?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That means canceling my race... A-are you
telling me not to run?!

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Please calm down.
All I'm saying is that we
should wait for a better
time. You can race
once you've gotten more used to—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wait, please! I can run now! I mean, I want to run now!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I need to be in the lead—

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
But you've yet to master your current
running style. Even you can see
that, can
you not?

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka please listen to me.
I'm just trying
to help ensure that you are
in top form for
your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Let's take some time to get you
accustomed to the correct technique.
You
will be racing and winning plenty after
that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: How much time... is "some time"?

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Trainer
text_block_list.text: Pardon? I didn't catch that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm... going home now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A dejected Suzuka totters off the track
with the faltering steps of a
lost child.
